title: Parallax Arena - Shifted Veil
description: A surreal floating arena composed of ancient stone platforms, ornate tiled flooring with glowing circular patterns, and a massive luminous hourglass filled with green liquid at the center. In the background are jagged mountains under a dramatic purple and yellow sky, with additional floating platforms, a stone bridge, and a large airship hovering in the distance.
